title: Concept: Link to a Git metadata file
description: A link into the .git directory in a response gives every reader the same view the bank has internally: .git/config lists remotes and sometimes embeds credentials in their URLs, and the directory also carries the full history that a scanner can reconstruct from.
applicability: Static hosting, framework debug pages and deployment trees that copy the repository root.
risk: The repository history exposes source, secrets that were committed once and the deployment process.
